spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end, w.data_end,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT c.*,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'called_below_pct') AS called_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_below_pct') AS early_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'min_overdue_phone') AS min_overdue_phone
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
WHERE c.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT c.return_known_n, c.returned_n, c.returned_early_pct, c.returned_later_pct, c.return_not_yet_known_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
WHERE c.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Called patients who visited within 30 days of the first call, for calls in the last 3 months. Early calls are made within 14 days of becoming overdue. Calls too recent to check are left out.
spec.title: Came back within 30 days, by when we called

spec.rawSql:
SELECT c.*
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
WHERE c.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT c.*,
  np.flag AS phone_flag, np.new_patients_n, np.new_usable_phone_n, np.new_usable_phone_pct,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'called_below_pct') AS called_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_below_pct') AS early_below_pct, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'early_days') AS early_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'return_days') AS return_days, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'calling' AND key = 'min_overdue_phone') AS min_overdue_phone,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_calling('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) c
LEFT JOIN report_new_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) np ON np.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = c.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

options.content: How this is worked out. Overdue patients are those on the overdue list with a phone number. A call is early if made within 14 days of becoming overdue. Came back within 30 days means a visit within 30 days of the first call. The Overdue tab counts 15 days. That count is in Overdue patients on the Hypertension tab, so the two numbers differ.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT n.*, w.window_end,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'new_patients' AND key = 'min_patients') AS min_patients, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'new_patients' AND key = 'phone_below_pct') AS phone_below_pct
FROM report_new_patients('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) n
CROSS JOIN report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE n.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'
